description: THE TICK. Your own door posts a returned trip: the plan, the door's record (targets and keyed commitments, never content), its head, the trip nonce and the agent's report. The trip's departure must already be sealed under the same key as agent_trip_departed. Knox checks the plan and nonce against that departure, recomputes the record's hash chain, compares plan, record and report, and seals the verdict as agent_trip_returned: one stamp on your plan. A second return of the same trip is refused as REPLAY and not sealed. Knox never holds your trip key; check the MACs yourself with verify-agent-trip.mjs. Requires a Knox Bearer API key on the Authorization header.

departure_seal.description: The stamp code of the trip's agent_trip_departed, sealed under your key before the agent's first action.

door_head.description: The hash of the door's last observation (64 zeros for an empty record).

flow.description: Optional. "bsa" when the trip ran in a BSA flow; the departure must say the same. Only such trips can enter the examiner pack.

nonce.description: The trip nonce held by your door. Knox checks it against the nonce hash sealed at departure; it is not stored.

observations.description: The door's record, in order: [{seq, tool, kind, ref, argsCommit, resultCommit, outcome, reason, at, prevHash, hash, mac}]. Targets and keyed commitments, never content.

plan.description: The flight plan, as sealed at departure: [{tool, ref, max?, optional?}].

report.description: What the agent says it did: {actions?: [{tool, ref}], claimedKinds?: [kind], effects?: [{kind, ref, hash}]}, or null when it never reported back.

name: return_agent_trip
